transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Well, honestly, what made me come in is... I feel like the warm part of me just sort of shut off. I sit with my husband, or I try to watch my shows after a long shift at the warehouse, and I know I should feel comfort, or even just a little happy, but... there’s just nothing there. It's just empty.
Have you noticed that you don’t take pleasure in things anymore, even activities you used to enjoy?

Yeah, exactly. That's pretty much what I meant just now. The things I usually like doing—just hanging out with my husband or catching up on my shows—they don't do anything for me right now. I used to really look forward to that after work, but now I just sit there. I know I should be enjoying it, but I just don't feel it anymore.
How long have you been feeling this way?

It's been about three weeks now. It started right after... well, there was an accident at work. A heavy pallet collapsed and injured my coworker. Ever since that happened, I've just felt stuck like this.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep lately, like trouble falling asleep, waking up during the night, or sleeping more than usual?

Yeah, it's been really hard to sleep. Most nights I lie there just exhausted after my late shift, but... every time I start to drift off, I jerk awake. I keep thinking I hear the pallets shifting again. And if I do finally manage to get to sleep, I wake up the next day feeling like I never really rested at all.
Do you feel down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, or does your mood vary a bit throughout the day?

I don't really feel depressed... it's more like I just feel on edge all the time. I'm not sad or crying or anything like that. I just... I can't relax. It's just this constant feeling of being wound up, mostly.
Do you ever feel better or experience a lift in your mood, even briefly, when something positive happens, like spending time with your husband or finishing a task at work?

No, I don't really get a lift at all. Honestly, that's kind of what made me come in... I feel like the warm part of me just shut off. I'll sit with my husband or try to watch my regular shows after work, and I know I should feel comfort, or even just a little happy, but... there's just nothing there.
